rows.name: Primary AA N50
rows.protocol: base seed 1; 50 trials; seeds 2--51; packet loss 0/0.1/0.2/0.5; counts 1/4/1/2
rows.role: Paired AA evidence for Tables I, III, IV, and Fig. 3; paired confidence intervals, wins, and sign-test values use the same per-trial packet-loss realizations.

rows.name: Held-out AA N50
rows.protocol: base seed 11; 50 trials; seeds 12--61; packet loss 0/0.1/0.2/0.5; counts 1/4/1/2
rows.role: Base-seed robustness check; generated after method selection and not used for parameter search.

rows.name: Contextual GA N50
rows.protocol: base seed 1; 50 trials; seeds 2--51; packet loss 0/0.1/0.2/0.5; counts 1/4/1/2
rows.role: Reference rows from the tracked GA validation path; same tiered profile, but not part of the paired AA sign tests.

rows.name: Independent verifier
rows.protocol: Recomputes network disagreement, runtime, and local E-OSPA/RMSE/CardErr from per-trial rows/logs.
rows.role: Build gate for report-driven numbers before PDF compilation.
